agyos_skill.instructions: The **account-strategy keystone** above `threads-post` — set the conversation-first channel strategy (niche, cadence, the reply-more-than-post engine, format mix, the Threads→IG funnel, metrics). The agent **strategizes + drafts the original posts + can draft suggested replies**; **WoopSocial publishes the original posts**; the **reply flywheel, Communities, DMs, dashboards, and analytics are human/native.** Threads (~500M MAU mid-2026; ~141.5M daily mobile, more than X; ~6.25% engagement, far above X) is **neither X nor Instagram** — a **conversation-first, positive** platform where dunks and negativity get **throttled.** The defining lever is **Mosseri's "reply much more than you post":** replies are weighted heaviest, your **own replies count**, and **first-hour engagement velocity is the #1 ranking factor.** It's an **interest graph** (For You surfaces new accounts), so small accounts can break out — but growth **compounds over 60–90 days.** WoopSocial publishes the original posts; the **reply flywheel is human.** 1. **brand-profile** — niche/voice. 2. **goals-and-kpis** — the growth goal + metric. (Depth: `references/the-talks-framework.md`.) - **T — Talk more than you post:** reply much more than you post; your own replies count; leap into relevant conversations fast. *The reply flywheel is run by a human/`community-management`.* - **A — Anchor one niche/angle:** one sharp value promise; niche consistency (1–2 areas) → interest-graph classification + trust. - **L — Land the first hour:** engagement velocity is the #1 factor (50 likes/30 min > 100/24h); post when the audience is awake and stay to reply; one topic tag. - **K — Keep it original + positive:** original > recycled (recycled demoted); **no engagement-bait** (downranked); positive/constructive (negativity throttled); photos +60% / video / links +17% under media; one topic tag. (Post craft → `threads-post`.) - **S — Sustain + funnel to Instagram:** 3–5/week (not >3/day); compounds over 60–90 days; Threads (discovery) → Instagram (conversion), repurpose top posts in 24–72h; track reach, replies ÷ reach, follower growth.
